# Sawda Digital - Premier Digital Marketing, Web, App & SEO Agency in Bangladesh

> Sawda Digital is a premier digital marketing agency based in Banani, Dhaka, Bangladesh. We offer a unified digital growth model combining high-ROI digital marketing (Meta & Google Ads), custom web development (Next.js, WordPress, Shopify), native & cross-platform mobile apps (iOS & Android), conversion-driven UI/UX design, and Page 1 Google SEO services that scale ambitious businesses.
